119776.name: Congregation Bais Menachem-Chabad
119776.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Moshe Wilhelm. Its chabad.org listing (2317 SW Vermont St) is a branch of Chabad Lubavitch of Oregon (listing 118188, 6612 SW Capitol Hwy), which began when Rabbi Moshe Wilhelm arrived in January 1984 (Jewish Federation of Greater Portland, 24 Jan 2020); the congregation's own start is not found, and it is a separate address, so 1984 is not taken as its year. It is Chabad of Oregon's own synagogue: its chabad.org listing calls it 'A department of Chabad Lubavitch of Oregon', and a kosher-travel guide (kosherlytrvl.com, Chabad of Northeast Portland page): 'Chabad of Oregon's headquarters and synagogue, Congregation Bais Menachem, is just off it on SW Vermont Street'. So it began between 1984 (Chabad of Oregon's start) and 2004 (its listing).

150725.name: Chabad of Ridgefield
150725.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director, and a web search for the older centres; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Sholom Deitsch. Connecticut Secretary of the State record (data.ct.gov, 'Connecticut Business Registry - Business Master'): 'CHABAD JEWISH CENTER OF NORTHERN FAIRFIELD COUNTY INC.' (account 1046606, Aug 19 2011; and account 2830875, July 2023, at 27 West Lane, the listing's address). So the filing is after the listing and is not taken as the year. Its site as archived Oct 9 2004: 'Chabad Jewish Center of Ridgefield • 10 Sarah Bishop Road • Ridgefield, CT 06877' (now 27R West Lane; in April 2016 the zoning board let Rabbi Deitsch run it from the two-family house where he lives, CrownHeights.info). Its old-directory number (mosad-id 3813) points to an entry made in the first half of 2004 (a lead, not a year).

earlier.where: 10 Sarah Bishop Road, Ridgefield ('Chabad Jewish Center of Ridgefield', its site as archived Oct 9 2004)

150728.name: Chabad Center for Jewish Life
150728.note: IRS (ProPublica): 'Chabad Outreach Center Of Emerald Hills Inc', care of Avraham Eliezer Barash, exempt from 2005-01, so it existed by then. Start year not found yet; lead: therebbesimpact.com 2003. Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N05000004044.json): CHABAD OF GREATER HOLLYWOOD, INC. (and CHABAD OF HOLLYWOOD, INC., N05000004046, the same day) (document N05000004044), filed 04/19/2005, officers Rabbis Raphael Tennenhaus, Menachem Tennenhaus and Laizer Barash; both dissolved 09/25/2009. Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-07-22, before the filing, so the filing is not the year (HANDOFF 4b). The listing shows it by 2004 (was by 2005). Its site as archived April 20 2005: 'ChabadEmeraldhills.com • 3250 Stirling Road #3 • Hollywood, FL 33021' (now 4001 N Park Road). Its old-directory number (mosad-id 3816) points to an entry made in the first half of 2004 (a lead, not a year).

earlier.where: 3250 Stirling Road #3, Hollywood ('the Chabad Center 3250 Stirling Rd', its site and calendar as archived April 20 2005)

155891.note: Rabbi Yitzchok and Pessy Gurevitz, 7334 Rural Lane, West Mt. Airy (its site chabadnwp.org, which in Oct 2026 asks people to call for its new Shabbat location). Its old-directory number (mosad-id 3818) points to an entry made in the first half of 2004 (a lead, not a year).

438221.name: Ohr Avner Community Center of Colorado
438221.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing went up 2006-10-23, so it existed by then. Director: David Araiev. Colorado Secretary of State record (data.colorado.gov, 'Business Entities in Colorado'): 'Ohr Avner Colorado' (formed 2025, agent David Araiev, the listing's director). So the filing is after the listing and is not taken as the year. Fallback (owner, Nov 11: 'I guess they can be low but obviously it must be noted'): no source found for its start (the searches above), so the year is the one its chabad.org listing went up (2006-10-23), entered as LOW. Checked first on the 685 centers that have a high-confidence year and a listing made after July 2004: 71% were listed the same year they began, 79% within a year, 10% three or more years later. Its site (ChabadAuroraCO.com, About Us): 'Chabad Aurora was established in 2014, to serve the Jewish community of Aurora'; 'Rabbi David and Nechama moved to Aurora and founded Chabad Aurora in 2014' (Rabbi David Araiev, the listing's director; IRS 'CHABAD OF AURORA COLORADO', ruling July 2025). But the listing is older and keeps its own name: Ohr Avner, 'a Sephardic congregation formed by the Bukharan community ... in Aurora' (Intermountain Jewish News, 27 Mar 2014); a 2011 community directory is said to list Rabbi Yaakov Abayov at Ohr Avner, 11100 E. Mississippi Ave. (search excerpt, not opened). So the 2006 listing year stays (low) for the congregation, and 2014 is when the Araievs came.
